neighbours.label: the first fragment of a word the tokenizer splits into pieces (bur-rowed, Storm-cloaks, stre-wn, inter-poser)
fire: The crabs had burrowed deep into the wet sand by morning.
Leaves were strewn across the lawn after the storm.
Ticks often burrow into the skin behind the ears.
The Stormcloaks marched on the city at dawn.
A small vole had burrowed under the garden shed.
Petals lay strewn along the aisle after the wedding.
She acted as an interlocutor between the two delegations.
Rabbits burrowing beneath the fence ruined the vegetable bed.
